before_record.title: Geometric linear-annihilator Hankel Segre bound in every characteristic
before_record.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
before_record.section: Statement and geometric hypothesis; divided squares; ordinary cyclic-source consequence
before_record.statement: Over any field K, for 1<=r<min(a,b) and 5r<2(a+b), a linear map Phi:U tensor V -> K^(a+b-1) whose symbolic decomposable Hankel image has all (r+1)-minors identically zero has image dimension at most B=max(r,k^2), k=max(1,floor((3r-a-b+4)/2)). The divided-square evaluation sequence retains diagonal constraints in characteristic two. An ordinary cyclic-source restriction containing M(l,h,n), with opposite-map kernel dimensions kY,kZ, therefore satisfies lh>Bab implies n+kY+kZ>=(r+1)ab.
dependencies: Pinned prior Hankel pencil-degree and scalar annihilator proofs
De Teran-Dopico-Mackey MIMS 2013.47 Lemma 6.3 over arbitrary fields
before_record.limitations: Requires geometric decomposable rank bounds or polynomial minor identities; finite-field rational-point checks alone are not substituted. Same numerical cap as characteristic zero. No singular-degeneration exclusion, constructed target, independent review, formalization or exponent improvement. Finite controls cover 911 evaluation fibers and 882 monomial assignment systems over F2,F3,F5 only.
